STEP 5. Check trunk lid latch switch connector F-16 and 
ETACS-ECU connector C-112 for damage.
Q: Are trunk lid latch switch connector F-16 and ETACS-
ECU connector C-112 in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 6.
NO : Repair or replace them. Refer to GROUP 00E, 
Harness Connector Inspection P.00E-2. The input 
signal from the trunk lid latch switch should be able to 
be checked and the functions, which are described in 
the "Technical Description (comment)," should work 
normally.
